column2: A single supplier's late shipments exposed a vulnerability in the retailer's entire holiday plan.
column3: 單一供應商的延遲出貨，暴露出這家零售商整個假期計畫的脆弱點。
column5: vulnerable 的名詞：盔甲上露出傷口的那個小洞
column7: vul - ner - a - bil - i - ty

column2: To test the assumption, apply negation: if the opposite were true, would the argument still work?
column3: 要檢驗這個假設，就做取非測試：如果相反情況為真，論證還成立嗎？
column5: negate 的名詞，把句子加上 not 看論證會不會垮

column2: A single reliable counterexample is enough to negate a sweeping claim about all customers.
column3: 一個可靠的反例，就足以否定關於所有顧客的籠統主張。
column5: neg 像 no：對結論說 no，讓它落空

column2: It is plausible that shoppers spend more when music plays, though no one has tested it yet.
column3: 顧客在有音樂時花更多錢，聽起來合理，不過還沒有人檢驗過。
column5: plaus 像 applause 掌聲：聽起來讓人想鼓掌的說法

column2: Few investors found the CEO's story implausible enough to doubt, yet the numbers never added up.
column3: 沒有幾位投資人覺得執行長的說法不可信到值得起疑，然而數字始終對不起來。
column4: an implausible story (難以置信的說法)
column5: im 不 + plausible 可信：聽了只想搖頭

column2: A coherent business case links market size, pricing, and costs into one clear line of argument.
column3: 條理連貫的商業論證，會把市場規模、定價與成本串成一條清楚的論述主線。
column4: a coherent plan (條理連貫的計畫)
column5: co 一起 + here 黏住：每句話都黏在一起，不散掉

column2: The incoherent proposal jumped between three strategies without ever explaining how they fit together.
column3: 這份語無倫次的提案在三種策略間跳來跳去，卻從未說明它們如何相互配合。
column4: an incoherent argument (支離破碎的論證)
column5: in 不 + coherent 黏住：句子散成一地，拼不起來

column2: The rationale behind the price cut was to clear old stock before the new model arrived.
column3: 降價背後的理由，是想在新機型到貨前清掉舊庫存。
column4: the rationale behind it (背後的依據)
column5: ration 像 reason 理由：做這件事的道理在哪裡

column2: A rational buyer compares total costs over five years instead of looking only at the sticker price.
column3: 理性的買家會比較五年的總成本，而不只是看標價。
column5: ration 像 reason：照道理想，不被情緒牽著走

column2: Panic selling during a mild dip struck many analysts as irrational, since the fundamentals had not changed.
column3: 輕微下跌時恐慌拋售，讓許多分析師覺得非理性，因為基本面並沒有改變。
column4: an irrational fear (非理性的恐懼)
column5: ir 不 + rational 理性：腦袋沒開機，只剩情緒

column2: Rising wages alone cannot justify a price hike if productivity has stayed flat.
column3: 如果生產力一直沒變，光憑薪資上漲不足以證明漲價是正當的。
column4: justify the cost (證明成本合理)
column5: just 公正 + ify 使：讓事情站得住，講得出道理

column2: The manager offered no justification for skipping the safety review before launching the product.
column3: 經理沒有為推出產品前略過安全審查提出任何正當理由。
column4: offer a justification (提出正當理由)
column5: justify 的名詞，給大家一個說得通的理由

column2: Spending extra on security is justifiable when the data being protected is worth millions.
column3: 當被保護的資料價值數百萬時，多花錢加強安全是說得過去的。
column5: justify 加 able：講得出理由，別人點頭同意

column2: Investors called the executive bonuses unjustified given that the firm had missed every target that year.
column3: 投資人認為，既然公司那年所有目標都沒達成，高階主管的獎金毫無依據。
column4: an unjustified claim (毫無依據的主張)
column5: un 沒有 + justified 理由：講不出道理的決定

column2: The founder asserted that the startup would break even within a year, though she showed no forecast.
column3: 創辦人斷言這家新創公司一年內就會損益兩平，不過她沒有拿出任何預測。
column5: as 向 + sert 插入：把旗子用力插下去，大聲宣布

column2: His assertion that remote work lowers output was backed by a single, poorly designed survey.
column3: 他認為遠距工作會降低產出的主張，只有一份設計不佳的問卷作為支持。
column5: assert 的名詞，一句斷言，沒附上證明

column2: Economists warn that causality is hard to prove from sales data that simply rise and fall together.
column3: 經濟學家警告，單憑一起起伏的銷售數據，很難證明其中有因果關係。
column5: cause 原因 + ality：A 真的造成 B 的那種關係

column2: Careful experiments, not casual observation, are needed to demonstrate causation between advertising and purchases.
column3: 要證明廣告與購買之間的因果作用，需要嚴謹的實驗，而不是隨意的觀察。
column4: causation, not correlation (因果而非相關)
column5: cause 原因 + ation：A 推了 B 一把的那股力量

column2: A strong correlation between ice cream sales and sunburns does not mean one causes the other.
column3: 冰淇淋銷量與曬傷之間的高度相關，並不代表其中一個導致另一個。
column5: co 一起 + relation 關係：兩個數字一起變，但不一定有因果

column2: Employee satisfaction tends to correlate with lower turnover, though the direction of influence is unclear.
column3: 員工滿意度往往與較低的離職率相關，但影響的方向尚不清楚。
column5: co 一起 + relate 關聯：兩條曲線手牽手一起升降

column2: A confounding factor, such as seasonal weather, may explain both the discount and the rise in sales.
column3: 季節性天氣之類的干擾因素，可能同時解釋折扣與銷售上升。
column5: con 一起 + found 倒入：把兩種原因混在一鍋，分不開

column2: Researchers changed only one variable, the price, so that any difference in demand could be traced to it.
column3: 研究人員只改變價格這一個變數，因此需求上的任何差異都能追溯到它。
column5: vary 變 + able：會變來變去的那個東西

column2: The match between the ad launch and the sales jump looked coincidental, since rivals closed stores that same week.
column3: 廣告上線與銷售大增的吻合看起來只是巧合，因為競爭對手同一週關閉了門市。
column5: co 同時 + incident 事件：兩件事湊巧同時發生

column2: An alternate explanation for the drop in sales is that a major competitor ran a promotion.
column3: 對銷售下降的另一種解釋，是一家主要競爭對手舉辦了促銷。
column5: alter 另一個：換成備用的那個解釋

column2: Before approving the merger, the board asked staff to present at least one realistic alternative.
column3: 批准合併前，董事會要求員工至少提出一個可行的替代方案。
column4: consider an alternative (考慮替代方案)
column5: alter 另一個 + native：除了原本的，還有別條路

column2: Extraneous noise in the data, such as one-time holiday orders, made the underlying trend hard to see.
column3: 資料中的無關干擾，例如一次性的節慶訂單，讓潛在趨勢難以看清。
column5: extra 外面 + neous：從外面闖進來的不速之客

column2: Because only loyal customers were surveyed, the results carried a built-in bias toward positive reviews.
column3: 因為只調查了忠實顧客，結果天生就偏向正面評價。
column5: bias 像「拜亞斯」：天秤被人偷偷壓住一邊

column2: A biased sample made up entirely of gym members would exaggerate how many people exercise daily.
column3: 完全由健身房會員組成的偏差樣本，會誇大每天運動的人數。
column4: a biased sample (有偏差的樣本)
column5: bias 加 ed：天秤被壓歪了，結果不公平

column2: To give an unbiased picture, the consultant gathered opinions from every department rather than only from managers.
column3: 為了提供公正無偏的全貌，顧問蒐集了每個部門的意見，而不只是經理們的。
column5: un 沒有 + biased 偏：天秤擺得水平，不偏袒

column2: A random sample of two hundred customers is usually enough to estimate the preferences of thousands.
column3: 隨機抽出兩百位顧客作為樣本，通常足以估計數千人的偏好。
column5: sample 像 example 去掉 ex：從全部中拿出的小小代表

column2: Poor sampling, such as surveying shoppers only on weekday mornings, can distort the entire study.
column3: 不良的抽樣方式，例如只在平日早晨訪問購物者，可能扭曲整份研究。
column5: sample 加 ing：動手從大鍋湯裡舀一小勺試味道

column2: The conclusion is only reliable if the group studied is representative of the whole customer base.
column3: 只有當被研究的群體能代表整個客群時，這個結論才可靠。
column4: a representative sample (具代表性的樣本)
column5: represent 代表 + ative：小小的縮影，像全班選出的班代

column2: Surveying only online shoppers gave an unrepresentative picture of a market where most sales happen in stores.
column3: 只訪問網路購物者，對一個多數銷售發生在實體店的市場，只會得到不具代表性的圖像。
column4: an unrepresentative group (不具代表性的群體)
column5: un 不 + representative：選出的班代跟全班完全不像
column7: un - rep - re - sen - ta - tive

column2: It is risky to generalize from one successful store to the performance of the whole chain.
column3: 從一間成功的門市推論整個連鎖店的表現，是有風險的。
column4: generalize from examples (從例子泛化推論)
column5: general 一般 + ize 使：把一個例子套到所有人身上

column2: The generalization that all younger buyers prefer apps overlooked the many who still shop in person.
column3: 「所有年輕買家都偏好使用應用程式」這個以偏概全的說法，忽略了許多仍親自去店裡購物的人。
column4: a sweeping generalization (過度籠統的推論)
column5: general 一般 + ization：用少數例子貼上全體標籤
column7: gen - er - al - i - za - tion

column2: Cancelling the product after one bad review would be a hasty decision, so wait for more feedback.
column3: 只因一則負評就取消產品會是倉促的決定，所以請等更多回饋。
column5: hasty 像「黑絲帶」快：腳步太快，沒看清就下結論

column2: The gap between the two groups was statistically meaningful, not merely the result of chance.
column3: 兩組之間的差距在統計上具有意義，並非只是機率造成的結果。
column5: statistic 統計 + ally：從數字角度看，才算數

column2: The statistical significance of the result meant there was less than a five percent chance it was random.
column3: 結果的統計顯著性意味著，它是隨機造成的機率低於百分之五。
column5: sign 記號 + ficance：這個記號夠大，不可能只是巧合

column2: The difference in conversion rates between the two web pages was significant at the one percent level.
column3: 兩個網頁的轉換率差異在百分之一的水準上達到顯著。
column5: sign 記號 + ficant：明顯到不能忽略的記號

column2: A two-cent change in price had an insignificant effect on demand, so the team ignored it.
column3: 價格變動兩分錢對需求的影響微不足道，所以團隊忽略了它。
column4: an insignificant change (微不足道的變化)
column5: in 不 + significant 顯著：小到可以不管的小螞蟻
